gbifID.description: Unique global biodiversity record identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each Asota plana sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each observation, always Animalia.

phylum.description: Arthropoda taxonomic division for all recorded specimens.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the observed species, consistently Lepidoptera.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the moth, consistently Erebidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the observed species, consistently Asota.

species.description: Species name of the observed moth, consistently Asota plana.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet designating subspecies name when recorded.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each observation, either species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed moth, including species and subspecies authority.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed moth, either Asota plana or its lacteata form.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship is missing for all observations.

countryCode.description: Country codes follow ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 for observation locations.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region (province/state) where each observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote that the species was observed at the location.

individualCount.description: Individual count data missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published each observation record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each observation.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of observation location measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation at observation site, measured in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth measurement not recorded for any observation.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Taxon identifier distinguishing two species codes used in the observation records.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier for Asota plana, constant value 6869T.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, uniformly indicating observations made by humans.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: Dataset identifier indicating all records belong to the Observations collection.

catalogNumber.description: Unique observation identifier assigned by the collection database.

recordNumber.description: Placeholder field containing no recorded values.

identifiedBy.description: Observer identifiers comprising personal names, usernames, and institutional codes for each record.

license.description: Creative Commons license applied to observation records, indicating usage permissions.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding rights to contributed observation data.

recordedBy.description: Observer names of individuals who documented each Asota plana sighting.

typeStatus.description: Type status information is missing for all observations.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Last interpretation timestamp of each observation.

mediaType.description: Media type of observation, indicating categories such as StillImage, Video, Audio, etc.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifiers.

asota_plana.description: 996 Asota plana observations (2005‑2026) with taxonomy, coordinates, dates, media, and observer metadata.

description: Records 996 Asota plana observations from 2005 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
